tagline: Keep project docs and tasks in sync between Notion and ClickUp
metaTitle: Notion + ClickUp Integration: Docs Linked to Tasks
metaDescription: Update Notion pages when ClickUp tasks change and create tasks from Notion action items. GAIA syncs project timelines. See the setup steps.
intro:
Project teams that use Notion for documentation and ClickUp for task management inevitably face the same problem: the two drift apart. A task gets completed but the spec page still says 'In Progress.' A project plan is updated but none of the tasks reflect the new requirements. Teams end up holding sync meetings not because there is important news to share, but simply to manually reconcile the state of two tools that should be speaking to each other automatically.

GAIA connects the two so documentation and task management stay in lockstep. When a task moves to a new status, GAIA can update the corresponding page. When a project document is published or updated with new requirements, GAIA can create or update the relevant tasks. Documentation and tasks become a unified project management environment where changes on one side are always reflected on the other.

This integration is particularly powerful for product teams where the product manager maintains specs in Notion and the engineering team tracks work in ClickUp, and for agencies that document project plans for clients and execute the tasks internally.

useCases.title: Update Notion pages when ClickUp tasks change status
useCases.description: When a task moves from 'In Progress' to 'Complete,' GAIA updates the status indicator on the linked page so project documentation reflects real-time task progress without anyone manually touching the page.

useCases.title: Create ClickUp tasks from Notion action items
useCases.description: When a document is updated with a new action item or requirement, GAIA parses the change and creates a corresponding task with the appropriate assignee, list, and due date derived from context in the page.

useCases.title: Sync project timelines between databases and tasks
useCases.description: GAIA maps database date properties to task due dates, keeping timeline data consistent in both tools. When a task deadline shifts, the project database updates automatically, and a date change in the database updates the task.

useCases.title: Generate meeting notes from sprint reviews
useCases.description: After a sprint review is logged in ClickUp, GAIA creates a structured page with the sprint summary, completed tasks, carry-over work, and blockers so project documentation grows automatically alongside task completion.

useCases.title: Archive completed tasks into project logs
useCases.description: GAIA periodically exports completed tasks into a Notion database structured as a project log, giving leadership and stakeholders a searchable, long-term record of what was delivered without cluttering the active workspace.

howItWorks.step: Connect Notion and ClickUp to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Notion workspace and ClickUp workspace through GAIA's integration settings. Select the pages and databases and the spaces and lists that should be linked for automated syncing.

howItWorks.step: Define your sync rules and mappings
howItWorks.description: Configure which pages correspond to which lists, how status fields map between the two tools, and whether sync should be one-directional or fully bidirectional. Use natural language to describe your workflow preferences.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps your docs and tasks aligned automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both tools for changes and propagates updates between them in real time. Your documentation always reflects the actual state of the work, and your task board always reflects the documented requirements.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync one database with multiple ClickUp lists simultaneously?
faqs.answer: Yes. A single database can be mapped to multiple lists, useful for projects that span several spaces or teams. GAIA handles the routing based on properties in the database, such as team, project type, or priority.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support Notion's relation and rollup properties?
faqs.answer: GAIA can read and write standard properties including selects, dates, text, and checkboxes. Relation and rollup properties are readable but writes to relation fields depend on the linked databases also being part of the configured integration.

faqs.question: What happens if a task is deleted — does GAIA delete the page?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA does not delete page content by default when a task is removed. Instead, it updates the page with a status note saying the task was deleted. Deletion must be explicitly configured or performed manually to prevent accidental data loss.
